guesses.reason: Small sturdy terrier build, wiry white coat with tan head shading, and upright brown-tinged ears are classic rough-coated Jack Russell traits.
The large, broad, upright ears and rounded skull suggest some Chihuahua influence in this small mix.
The scruffy, whiskery facial furnishings and wheaten-tan highlights are reminiscent of wire-coated terriers like the Cairn or Wire Fox Terrier.

breed.appearance: A small, compact dog with a scruffy, wiry coat that is mostly creamy white, with light tan-wheaten shading across the forehead, brows, and top of the head and darker grayish-brown smudges around the eyes. Large, upright, triangular ears are rich reddish-brown on the backs and edges with wispy white hairs sticking out, framing round, dark brown, expressive eyes and a black button nose. Long, tousled whiskers and a shaggy white beard surround a happy open mouth with a pink tongue, and he wears a green harness with a gold heart-shaped tag.
breed.fun_fact: Jack Russell Terriers are bundles of energy and smarts who love games, adventures, and making their people laugh!
